note: Selected extracts, not complete use directions. Check the container label, seed tag and state requirements. An EPA import does not constitute a label review.

records.targets: Soybean sudden death syndrome, early-season Septoria brown spot, charcoal rot; cyst, root-knot, reniform, lesion and lance nematodes.
records.rate: Soybeans: 1.52–3.04 fl oz product/100 lb seed, or 0.714–1.428 fl oz/140,000 seeds (weight conversion assumes 3,000 seeds/lb).
records.application: Water-based slurry with commercial seed-treatment equipment; on-farm use is subject to crop restrictions. No hopper-box, planter-box or slurry-box application at planting.
records.rei: 12 hours; a soil-incorporated-seed exception has WPS conditions.
records.ppe: Long sleeves, long pants, shoes/socks and label-specified chemical-resistant gloves; see section 2.2 for materials and requirements.
records.restrictions: Soybean section carries a California registration qualification. No soybean hay, forage or silage use. Annual pydiflumetofen limit: 0.357 lb ai/acre across seed and foliar uses. Consult the full label.

records.targets: Soybeans: labeled control of listed Rhizoctonia, Fusarium and Phytophthora seedling diseases, seed-borne Phomopsis, and Aspergillus/Penicillium seed rot. Pythium is listed for suppression.
records.rate: Soybeans: 0.25 fl oz product/140,000 seeds (0.50 fl oz/100 lb at 2,800 seeds/lb).
records.application: Commercial facilities or mobile treaters using closed transfer, mixing/loading, calibration and treatment. No hopper-box, planter-box or slurry-box use.
records.rei: 12 hours; consult the agricultural-use requirements and applicable exceptions.
records.ppe: See full label; handler PPE not transcribed into this extract.
records.restrictions: Add an approved colorant. Treated seed is not for food, feed or oil. Follow bag-label requirements. No subsequent foliar/soil OSBP-inhibitor application following this seed treatment; consult complete resistance directions.
